title: 집일까, 주택일까? 고유어·한자어·외래어 구별하기
objective: You can tell whether a common word is native, Sino-Korean, or a loanword, and choose between pairs like 집/주택 in everyday sentences.
summary: Korean often has a native word (고유어), a Sino-Korean word (한자어), and a loanword (외래어) for one idea, and each fits a different situation.

task.title: Sort and choose words
task.line: Sort each word into its group, then pick the word from the choices given in each question that fits each sentence best.

words.meaning: home, house (고유어, native Korean; the everyday word)
words.example: 주말에는 집에서 쉬는 게 제일 좋아요.
words.exampleMeaning: On weekends, resting at home is the best.

words.meaning: house, especially a detached house as opposed to an apartment (한자어; more formal)
words.exampleMeaning: My parents live in a house with a yard.

words.meaning: house (외래어; used in compound names like 게스트하우스, 비닐하우스)
words.exampleMeaning: I stayed at a guesthouse on Jeju Island for three days.

words.meaning: nation, state (한자어; used in news, sports, and official contexts)
words.example: 환경 문제는 모든 국가가 함께 풀어야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: Every nation has to solve environmental problems together.

words.meaning: speech, way of talking (고유어; also 'language' in words like 한국말)
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling talks too fast.

words.meaning: language (한자어; used when counting or comparing languages)
words.example: 저는 세 가지 언어를 할 수 있어요.

words.meaning: family celebration, feast (고유어; traditional events like a birthday for an older relative)
words.example: 할아버지 생신에 가족들이 모여서 잔치를 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The family got together and had a celebration for Grandfather's birthday.

words.example: 금요일에 친구 집에서 생일 파티를 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: We're having a birthday party at a friend's place on Friday.

exercises: Write 고유어 (native), 한자어 (Sino-Korean), or 외래어 (loanword) for each word: ① 하늘 ② 학교 ③ 버스
Choose 집, 주택, or 하우스: ① 수업이 끝나면 바로 ____에 가요. ② 이 동네에는 아파트보다 단독____이 많아요. ③ 호텔보다 싼 게스트____를 찾고 있어요.
Choose 나라 or 국가: ① 너는 어느 ____ 사람이야? ② 그 선수는 축구 ____ 대표예요.
Choose 말 or 언어: ① 외국 친구가 한국____을 잘해서 놀랐어요. ② 이 앱으로 여러 ____를 번역할 수 있어요.
Choose 잔치 or 파티: ① 다음 주 토요일에 조카 돌____가 있어요. ② 크리스마스 ____에 뭐 입고 갈 거예요?
answers: ① 고유어 ② 한자어 ③ 외래어
① 집 ② 주택 ③ 하우스
